content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) was ordered for a patient presenting with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10).
